boardRow.name: The Trestle
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A rail crossing over the gorge: hold both approaches while the ore carts run.

goals: Build on both approaches and survive through wave 12.
Trestle Crossing: see the ore cart safely over the gorge.
rules: The trestle is the only easy crossing over deep water.
Rail Toughs and Steam Wreckers press both approaches.
The south bank beside the base remains open for sluice work.
Coal seams lie along the mine spur on the south approach, west of the boiler site.
briefing.geographyLine: One long rail line crosses a deep river gorge between defended approaches.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar is bearing down on the trestle.
baron.defeatBeat: The last ore cart clears the gorge under its own steam.
